summary: The PR addresses the issue of StrPrinter settings being ignored for certain subexpressions by ensuring that the printer settings are applied consistently across different types of expressions. However, there are some minor issues related to maintainability and documentation.

issues.description: Some lines are unnecessarily long and could be split for better readability.
There are no new tests added to verify the fix, although the existing tests pass. It would be beneficial to add specific tests for the fixed cases.
